tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Return a factual overview of SavedThat: what the service does, which video platforms it supports, the current plan limits and prices, and links to its apps and documentation. Use it to answer questions about the product itself. It reads no user data.

tools.name: get_public_transcript
tools.description: Look up one video URL (YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels or TikTok) in SavedThat's public transcript index and return the opening excerpt of that transcript plus the link to its public page.
